# ChromaCalm

> Zero-install spectral notch filtering web tool for photophobia, migraine, and screen halation. By Paul Kirby.

- Live app: https://markkirby125.github.io/chromacalm/
- Repo: https://github.com/markkirby125/chromacalm
- Part of Vision Apps: https://github.com/markkirby125/vision-apps
